system.description: You touch your throat and speak a vow. Whatever the result, you cannot lie for 10 minutes.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but it lasts 1 hour.
outcomes.success: For 10 minutes, you know when someone tells you a deliberate lie, because their words sound like discordant static.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails, and you gain nothing for your vow.
outcomes.ruin: Every word sounds like static, true or not: you are Deafened for 10 minutes. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
